description: Create a keyword group: a name (unique per workspace), optionally your own id for it (externalId, unique too, a customer id say), and optionally its own company description (context: who the business is, what it sells, for whom), which the classifier reads in place of the whole workspace profile (guidelines and competitors included) for this group's keywords, so a rule for the group goes in that text. One group per customer with its description is how a reseller gets each customer judged as itself. Then pass its id as groupId to add_keyword.

anyOf.description: What the classifier reads as "the company" for this group's keywords, instead of the WHOLE workspace profile (guidelines and competitors included). Null: the workspace profile. See [Groups](/guides/groups#a-company-description-per-group).

context.description: What the classifier reads as "the company" for this group's keywords, instead of the WHOLE workspace profile (guidelines and competitors included). Null: the workspace profile. See [Groups](/guides/groups#a-company-description-per-group).

anyOf.description: Your own id for the group (a customer id, say). Unique per workspace; find the group by it with GET /v1/groups?externalId=.

externalId.description: Your own id for the group (a customer id, say). Unique per workspace; find the group by it with GET /v1/groups?externalId=.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

name.description: The group's name: a customer, a campaign, a product. Unique per workspace.

name: create_group
title: Create group
